review_status: Evidence reviewed 2026-11-17. FishBase and California coastal survey references support demersal kelp/rock habitat and broad depth occurrence; numeric SST preference remains unsupported.

profile.size: Min limit None / Bag limit 10 per harvester / day aggregate
profile.diet: Small fish, crustaceans, squids, and pelagic prey
profile.behavior: Navigates West Coast kelp forests, rocky reefs, and coastal upwelling zones.

factors.reason_template: Water is {value} C, inside preferred Pacific temperature range for kelp rockfish.
factors.value_notes: The reviewed sources document kelp/rock habitat and distribution but provide no species-specific numeric SST preference or tolerance curve for adult kelp rockfish. The configured 11-18 °C range and 13-17 °C ideal are not substantiated by the cited habitat records; retain values unchanged and mark needs_source.

factors.reason_template: Depth is {value} m, within prime Pacific depth zone for kelp rockfish.
factors.value_notes: FishBase reports demersal occurrence from 9-46 m, usually on or near the bottom in kelp beds and rocky areas; the California coastal survey appendix reports 0-46 m. This supports the configured 1-40 m outer interval broadly, but not the 3-35 m ideal as a measured preference curve.
